groups.title: Nonactive foundation and suffix inventory
groups.proposal: Derive nonactive verbstems from typed active imperfective sources with the licensed ō, lō, hua, o-hua, lo-hua, and hua-lō formations, keeping misleading traditional spellings separate from morphology.
groups.writingJob: Accept a typed active verbstem Result, locate its imperfective active base, derive only licensed nonactive suffix candidates, and preserve the dependency from imperfective nonactive to perfective nonactive.
groups.readingJob: Show the active base, suffix morphemes, true boundaries, and why written oa or loa may conceal o-hua or lo-hua.
groups.decisionSplit: The user requests a nonactive derivation and chooses a suffix only when the typed source genuinely licenses more than one final stem; the application derives base shape, boundaries, and later perfective formation.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse the familiar derivation request and option list; do not ask for imperfective base, connective identity, spelling segmentation, or perfective dependency.

groups.title: Regular lō formation and root-plus-ya loss
groups.proposal: Apply the frequent lō formation to its licensed transitive and Class C sources, using the future-shaped imperfective base and automatically dropping ya from the narrow root-plus-ya class.
groups.writingJob: Validate lō eligibility from the typed source class and final shape, choose the active imperfective base already used by the future, and apply the root-plus-ya deletion rule where licensed.
groups.readingJob: Show each source beside its derived lō stem, distinguish ordinary attachment from root-plus-ya loss, and keep inventory examples non-authoritative.
groups.decisionSplit: The user supplies or selects the active Source; the application derives ordinary lō attachment and root-plus-ya deletion without a separate exception switch.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse Source selection and the nonactive derivation request; do not add class, future-base, or drop-ya controls.

groups.title: Class C and D lō plus irregular lo-hua
groups.proposal: Handle Class C lengthening, Class D reduced-long spelling, exceptional long-vowel behavior, and the small suppletive or compound lo-hua family through their typed source structures.
groups.writingJob: Apply Class C final-vowel lengthening before lō, Class D reduced-long realization, licensed lexical exceptions, suppletive lo-hua bases, and first-member attachment inside the listed compound stems.
groups.readingJob: Expose the actual base chosen, vowel length or reduced-long spelling, suppletion, and the compound member that receives lo-hua.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses among genuinely licensed alternative nonactive formations; the application derives class effects, suppletive base, and compound attachment site.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse typed verb class, lexical Source, derivation options, and clickable stem structure; do not add manual lengthening, reduced-vowel, suppletion, or compound-member switches.

groups.title: The ō nonactive formation
groups.proposal: Derive ō nonactive stems from the licensed final environments, automatically deleting the final vowel and applying the resulting consonant changes while preserving listed lō alternatives.
groups.writingJob: Validate the source-final environment, form the replacive imperfective base, apply s-to-x and qu-to-c changes, and issue only the licensed ō or lō alternatives.
groups.readingJob: Show the deleted vowel, consonant result, replacive imperfective status, and any real alternative nonactive stem.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses between ō and lō only when the source licenses both; the application derives truncation and consonant changes.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse the nonactive option list and derived stem cues; do not add deletion or sound-change switches.

groups.title: The o-hua nonactive formation
groups.proposal: Derive regular and exceptional o-hua nonactive stems from typed final environments, including compensatory lengthening, consonant changes, optional n-o-hua, and rare transitive sources.
groups.writingJob: Build the replacive imperfective base, delete eligible final vowels and w, apply compensatory length and consonant changes, and preserve only listed exceptional or optional formations.
groups.readingJob: Show the true o-hua boundary, every deletion or length change, and why traditional oa spelling does not define the grammar.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses a licensed alternative where more than one nonactive Result exists; the application derives regular o-hua and lexical exceptions.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse source analysis and derivation options; do not expose compensatory lengthening, consonant replacement, or spelling fusion as grammar controls.

groups.title: The hua nonactive formation
groups.proposal: Derive hua nonactive stems from licensed i- and o-final sources, preserving vowel length, listed transitive extensions, ci-to-xī replacement, and the misleading written-a projection after o.
groups.writingJob: Validate hua eligibility, preserve or lengthen the final vowel as required, apply narrow ci-to-xī replacement, and authorize listed transitive or Class C extensions.
groups.readingJob: Show retained or lengthened vowels, the hua suffix, exceptional source type, and any spelling that hides hua after o.
groups.decisionSplit: The user selects a Source and chooses among real hua or other nonactive alternatives; the application derives vowel behavior and narrow exceptions.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse lexical Source and nonactive alternatives; do not add vowel-length, ci-replacement, or written-a switches.

groups.title: hua-lō free variants
groups.proposal: Offer the rare hua-lō formation only as a typed free variant of a licensed hua nonactive stem.
groups.writingJob: Validate the lexical source and issue hua-lō only where Andrews licenses it beside hua.
groups.readingJob: Show hua and hua-lō as separate valid Results without treating frequency as grammatical authority.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses hua or hua-lō only when both Results are licensed.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse the normal derivation option list; do not add a rarity or free-variant switch.

groups.title: Nonactive Class A behavior and perfective formation
groups.proposal: Treat every derived nonactive stem as Class A and derive its imperfective and perfective variants with the licensed long-final behavior before sounded or silent VNC material.
groups.writingJob: Assign Class A to the nonactive Result, derive its perfective from the nonactive imperfective, and choose long or reduced final o realization from the following typed morphs.
groups.readingJob: Show Class A membership, imperfective-to-perfective dependency, and why the same nonactive stem has long and reduced variants.
groups.decisionSplit: The user selects the intended tense or VNC Result later; the application derives nonactive class and vowel variant from the following morphological environment.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse ordinary mood, tense, and VNC generation; do not add nonactive-class or vowel-variant controls.
